library.kw_000:r_5fc8009a10283f8d.text:
An inter-dimensional war in $$ＡＤＷ$$ (= 'The 2nd Super Robot Wars Z: Destruction Chapter').
Centred on the $$新帝国インペリウム$$ raising an army of Dimensional Beasts, the three great nations of Earth pursued their own agendas while battles raged against hostile alien species, some of them intelligent life.
In the middle of that war, the members of $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ crossed over from $$ＵＣＷ$$.
In the end the special international rescue team $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ brought down $$ガイオウ$$, King of Destruction and ruler of the $$新帝国インペリウム$$, and the fighting ended.
This chain of battles sharpened every nation's sense of crisis and gave birth to the Earth Federation - which was also the beginning of a new war.

library.kw_000:r_fee437bed0c74d09.text:
An inter-dimensional war in $$ＡＤＷ$$, about a year after the $$破界事変$$ (= 'The 2nd Super Robot Wars Z: Regeneration Chapter').
As the Holy $$インサラウム$$ Kingdom, which ruled the Earth of a parallel world, invaded in search of new land, conflict inside the Earth Federation and battles against hostile alien species broke out at the same time.
In the end the Earth Federation Forces' independent external unit $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ brought down $$インサラウム$$'s leader and the revived $$ガイオウ$$, King of Destruction, and the fighting ended.
The $$次元力$$ extraction system '$$ＺＯＮＥ$$' that $$インサラウム$$ installed during that war still stands in various places, shut down, even after the $$新世時空震動$$.

library.kw_000:r_faad6f8fa908c2c4.text:
A hole in dimensions opened by $$アイム$$ Liard late in the $$再世戦争$$, connecting parallel worlds.
The state of the hole is closely tied to the motion of the stars of the galaxy; when it appeared it joined $$ＡＤＷ$$ and $$ＵＣＷ$$.
After the $$再世戦争$$ ended, the members of $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ used the $$アビス$$ to return to $$ＵＣＷ$$, the world they came from.
By the calculations of the time, the $$アビス$$ would grow unstable again and $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ would not be reconnected for roughly another year.

library.kw_000:r_762ac63151f051e5.text:
A mark branded on those fated to be tossed about by spacequakes. It is read as '$$烙印$$'.
What it means, what it actually does, what kind of person is chosen and by whom - all of it is unknown.
At present it is said to be carried by the members of the former $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.

library.kw_000:r_da3b33a0f6acb978.text:
Full name $$アイム$$ Liard.
Holder of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and the man who pilots the mobile weapon Arietis.
In the $$破界事変$$ he summoned $$ガイオウ$$, King of Destruction, to sow chaos in the world, and worked in the shadows as a staff officer of the $$新帝国インペリウム$$.
He was believed killed in the battle at the South Pole late in the $$破界事変$$, but that death was a mimicry produced by his $$スフィア$$'s power.
For his own ends he supplied dimensional science to $$インサラウム$$'s $$アンブローン・ジウス$$. Most of his intent is unknown, but behind his joining of the two worlds through the $$アビス$$ late in the $$再世戦争$$ there seems to lie something beyond merely hunting other $$スフィア$$ holders.
The $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$ governs human falsehood, and its holder's words and deeds are so full of lies that his true feelings are hard to grasp. He is also half absorbed into the $$スフィア$$, and when his emotions run high he becomes unable to say anything true - that is, anything meaningful.
$$アイム$$ Liard is an alias; his real name is Hermal Argo. He was originally a researcher of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and his aptitude led to the $$スフィア$$ absorbing him.
Late in the $$再世戦争$$ he was neutralised by $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ wielding the $$スフィア$$ of the Inquisitive Goat, the natural predator of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and met his end at the hands of $$ユーサー$$ $$インサラウム$$, ruler of the Holy $$インサラウム$$ Kingdom he had been using.

library.kw_000:r_44ead4450a866673.text:
Among spacetime disasters, the phenomena that carry land across with them.
By contrast, when no land is displaced and only objects or people move, or space merely distorts, it is called a dimensional tremor.
The distinction between the two is vague, however, and the terms are sometimes used purely by scale.

library.kw_000:r_8af3edbe9ec72dcb.text:
One of the $$堕天翅$$ tribe who fought humanity twelve thousand years ago.
She was betrothed to Apollonius, the strongest of the guardian winged ones, but when he betrayed the $$堕天翅$$ tribe they crossed blades as enemies. Even so, twelve thousand years did not fade that love, and she approached Apollo, apparently his reincarnation, again and again.
At the end of that love and hatred, when the world faced ruin, she achieved Divine Union together with Apollo and Sirius and held the shattering world together.

library.kw_000:r_cade0f7500a291f5.text:
A winged race living in Atlandia at the South Pole.
They possess a range of psychic powers and attack humanity in search of the life energy 'prana', fielding mythological beasts and Cherubim soldiers.
'$$堕天翅$$' is what humans call them; they call themselves the Winged Ones.
They call humans 'the wingless' and look down on them as inferior creatures.
Twenty-four thousand years ago the $$堕天翅$$ Apollonius fell in love with the human woman Celiane and betrayed his own kind, then defeated the $$堕天翅$$ with Aquarion, the Mechanical Angel built from his own wings.
Twelve thousand years ago the boys and girls newly chosen as Elements piloted Aquarion and fought the revived $$堕天翅$$ tribe. That war ended with the power of human and winged one becoming one, and the collapsing Earth saved.

library.kw_000:r_23cf424f79dd9416.text:
A teaching placement scheme trialled in $$第２新東京市$$, the research campus city. It extends the usual placement of about a month to a full year, so that the trainee learns a teacher's role across a whole year of school events. Taking part in extracurricular activities such as clubs and volunteering is encouraged for the same reason.
A student chosen for the placement needs more than enthusiasm: they must have earned all the credits required for graduation (the placement itself aside) by their third year.

library.kw_000:r_c22f1172e450faac.text:
A city newly developed outside Tokyo's 23 wards.
As a research campus city it gathers everything from local primary schools to universities and vocational colleges, built on the concept of education across the city as a whole.

library.kw_000:r_984b9b791c366e3b.text:
The enormous spacequake that fused $$ＵＣＷ$$, $$ＡＤＷ$$ and other worlds into one.
Vast in scale, but the physical damage was comparatively light, and $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ - culturally similar - grasped the situation quickly and were able to cooperate. As a result, in only three months a huge political body including the space colonies, the Earth Federation, was born, and people's lives returned to calm in a short time.

library.kw_000:r_f1ecef161f555bbf.text:
The enormous spacequake that fused $$ＵＣＷ$$, $$ＡＤＷ$$ and other worlds into one.
Vast in scale, but the physical damage was comparatively light, and $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ - culturally similar - grasped the situation quickly and were able to cooperate. As a result, in only three months a huge political body including the space colonies, the Earth Federation, was born, and people's lives returned to calm in a short time.
However, once it became clear that this had completed the Prison of Time, it was suspected that the $$新世時空震動$$ itself had been caused by someone's design, and an explanation is still awaited.

library.kw_000:r_a9f255bd1eccd141.text:
One of the parallel worlds (= the world of 'Super Robot Wars Z').
The name is short for '$$宇宙世紀$$ World'.
In the chaos immediately after the $$大時空震動$$, the $$多元戦争$$ broke out.
It is marked by violent displacement of land by spacequakes: apart from the Japanese archipelago and a few other places, the shape of its continents changed drastically from the old Earth.

library.kw_000:r_a6c543848e2758b6.text:
One of the parallel worlds (= the world of 'The 2nd Super Robot Wars Z').
The name is short for 'Anno Domini World'.
Its situation was comparatively stable, but twenty years after the $$大時空震動$$ it was struck by two inter-dimensional wars in succession: the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$.
It is marked by two Japanese archipelagos, two moons, and a continent sealed off by a dimensional wall. The wall covering that continent vanished early in the $$破界事変$$, and one of the two moons vanished late in the $$再世戦争$$.

library.kw_000:r_f14cc53a44932035.text:
An enormous spacequake that occurred in a certain world.
Its shock collapsed the walls separating every parallel world, and a great many multiverses came into being.
It is held to have been caused by the runaway of a weapon called a $$時空震動弾$$, though much about the bomb's developer and the origin of the technology remains a mystery.
Those present at the site of the $$大時空震動$$ are called singularities, and are considered indispensable to the $$時空修復$$ that would reconstitute the multiverse.

library.kw_000:r_c51809db1c711b75.text:
The International Criminal Police Organization.
Formed from the initials of 'International Criminal Police Organization', it is also known as Interpol.

library.kw_000:r_c78267ead7aa9da2.text:
Short for '$$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Extra Merchant) Corporation', a company that travels between parallel worlds.
It also refers to that corporation's mobile weapon series, '$$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Energy Machinery)'.
$$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation's employees call themselves dimensional merchants and take pride in doing business across a variety of parallel worlds.
$$ＡＧ$$ is one of their agent robots, but is currently cut off, unable to contact head office.

library.kw_000:r_9495c430a862d6b2.text:
Short for '$$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Extra Merchant) Corporation', a company that travels between parallel worlds.
It also refers to that corporation's mobile weapon series, '$$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Energy Machinery)'.
$$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation's employees call themselves dimensional merchants and take pride in doing business across a variety of parallel worlds.
$$ＡＧ$$ is one of their agent robots, but is currently cut off, unable to contact head office. With the Prison of Time destroyed, however, a change in that situation is hoped for.

library.kw_000:r_9193b43ea6038738.text:
$$ミスリル$$'s ground combat unit.
The name is short for 'Special Response Team'.
The $$ＳＲＴ$$ handles only those operations that the initial response team 'PRT', who might be called the rank and file, cannot.

library.kw_000:r_a35880cf4c261c33.text:
A private military provider.
Short for 'Strategic Military Services'.
Ostensibly a transport company, it takes on missions the New United Nations Forces cannot handle: operational testing of new weapons, investigation of and combat against unknown enemies.
Branches exist in various fleets; the Frontier fleet's unit uses the Macross Quarter as its mothership, commanded by that ship's captain, Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$.
